text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Standing at 180 cm, the super-sized 
Umamusume Hishi Akebono's dream is to 
become "someone who brings complete 
satisfaction to everyone, myself included, 
through racing"—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She had drawn attention for her large 
build even before her debut. ...However, 
making full use of a large frame requires 
a truly resilient body.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Focusing on physical conditioning for the 
time being, her days of taking on the 
Twinkle Series had begun!
